title: Quant Eval Assertion Engine + Golden Set Orchestration
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build an automated evaluation "harness" (assertion engine) that runs quantized model candidates (FP8 / INT8 profiles) through curated golden prompt suites and calibration workflows to produce pass/fail signals, rich metrics, and human-readable regression summaries. The engine should be CI-friendly, support per-deployment gates (hosted/dedicated/private), and produce artifacts that tie into rollouts and rollback policies.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible pipeline executes N=3 independent runs per model/profile and produces deterministic pass/fail decisions given a fixed seed
Golden prompt suite runner supports tagging by domain, length, and failure-mode (accuracy, hallucination, formatting)

Metrics emitted: per-token cross-entropy delta, top-k token accuracy, BLEU/ROUGE for structured tasks, hallucination score (LM-consistency), response-length distributions, and latency/throughput per profile
Configurable thresholds and gating rules stored in config repo (per-model, per-profile) that the CI can evaluate to block merges or trigger canary rollouts
Calibration workflow orchestrator runs full calibration dataset, produces calibration tables and quantization error heatmaps, and uploads artifacts to S3/console
Integration with Console: results annotated on model page and rollback recommended when regression > configured CI gate
Test flakiness detector flags unstable prompts and quarantines them for triage (with example traces)
Documentation summarizing how to add golden prompts and how thresholds were derived is published to Confluence and linked from the UI
tasks: Design assertion engine schema and JSON result spec (metrics, traces, status)
Implement golden prompt runner with TTL and retry semantics
Hook calibration job to quant builder that emits calibration artifacts
Implement gating logic and config parser for per-model thresholds
Add CI job (github actions) that runs harness on PRs for quant profiles above a size threshold
Visualize results in Console and attach downloadable artifacts (CSV/PNG/JSON)
Create onboarding doc + tutorial for engineers to add golden prompts and thresholds
comments: 2025-02-16: Kickoff meeting notes - agreed to reuse parts of the eval runner from ENG-7521 but to significantly rework result schema for gating. Action: Asha to draft schema.

2025-02-20: Design review - PM requested explicit hallucination metric. Decided to implement LM-consistency check (compare generated answer to a high-precision reference LM) and a simple entity-matching fallback for structured outputs.

2025-02-24: Engineering spike completed - prototype demonstrates per-token CE delta is more stable than raw accuracy for short prompts. Spike notebook uploaded: drive.redwood/quant/spikes/ce-delta-vs-accuracy.ipynb
2025-03-01: UX review with Console team - Luca to add a compact regression summary card. Console PR: github.com/redwood/console/pull/4123

2025-03-04: Blocker discovered - some calibration runs vary due to nondeterministic weight ordering in the quant builder. Mitigation: pin seed and add deterministic quant builder flag. Follow-up ticket created ENG-18672
notes: Key trade-offs discussed: stricter gates reduce rollout risk but increase release friction. We'll provide a 'soft-fail' mode for staged rollout testing and telemetry collection. Calibration artifacts may be large; initial plan is to keep full artifacts for 30 days and compressed summaries indefinitely. We'll also tier golden prompts into fast smoke tests vs. full-sweep regression tests to balance CI runtime.
